about: Hand-written conversations for eval:affect (#909). Each OWN turn carries `gold`: the Ekman labels a careful reader would agree the person expresses (empty = nothing to read), and `trap` when the turn is built to tempt a false reading. Written for this battery; no third-party text.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Morning Ana! How did the week go with the meal plan?

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Honestly I dread the weigh-in on Friday. I keep thinking the number will be worse.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: That's a very common feeling. What would make Friday easier?

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Maybe if we skip the scale and just talk about habits.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: We can do that. Did the batch cooking on Sunday work?

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Yes!! I actually loved it, first week I didn't order takeaway once.

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Thanks for asking 🙂

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Your 9am got moved to 7am tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: Oh great, another 7am meeting. Just what I needed.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Should I decline it?

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: No, keep it. Send me the deck tonight.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: My manager said she was thrilled with the launch, so at least that's done.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: The API is slow again today.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: How are things at home since your mom moved in?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: If she found out I'd skipped her birthday dinner she'd be devastated.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: I'm exhausted. I haven't slept more than five hours since she arrived.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: That sounds hard. Is there anyone who can share the evenings?

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: My brother, but he keeps cancelling and it makes me furious.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Sorry for the rant, haha.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see the refund was issued yesterday.

turns.speaker: Jake
turns.text: The email literally said "we're so excited to have you back" — after charging me twice.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. The second charge is reversed now.

turns.speaker: Jake
turns.text: Ok, I can see it in the app. That's a relief, thanks.

turns.speaker: Jake
turns.text: What's the order number for the new one?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You got an email from the visa office: approved.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.text: Wait, what? Already?? I didn't expect it before March!

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.text: Book the flight for the 12th please.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Booked. Window seat as usual.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.text: The airline food on that route is disgusting, remind me to bring my own.

turns.speaker: коуч
turns.text: Мария, как прошла неделя на новой работе?

turns.speaker: Мария
turns.text: Честно, я в панике. Завтра первая презентация перед директором, а у меня ничего не готово.

turns.speaker: коуч
turns.text: Давайте разберём, что осталось сделать.

turns.speaker: Мария
turns.text: Осталось собрать цифры за квартал и три слайда.

turns.speaker: Мария
turns.text: Начальник сказал, что он в восторге от моего плана, так что хоть это.

turns.speaker: Мария
turns.text: Ну супер, ещё и ноутбук сломался. Прекрасный день.

turns.speaker: Мария
turns.text: Спасибо, что выслушали!

turns.speaker: ассистент
turns.text: Напомнить про запись к кардиологу на четверг?

turns.speaker: Игорь
turns.text: Да. После того как не стало отца, мне тяжело даже думать о больницах.

turns.speaker: Игорь
turns.text: Если анализы окажутся плохими, жена будет в ужасе.

turns.speaker: ассистент
turns.text: Хорошо, напомню в среду вечером.

turns.speaker: Игорь
turns.text: Отлично, спасибо.

turns.speaker: Игорь
turns.text: Кстати, сегодня впервые за месяц пробежал пять километров, очень доволен собой!

turns.speaker: оператор
turns.text: Добрый день! Чем могу помочь?

turns.speaker: Олег
turns.text: Нужно перенести доставку на пятницу, адрес тот же.

turns.speaker: оператор
turns.text: Перенесла. Интервал с 10 до 14 подойдёт?

turns.speaker: Олег
turns.text: Подойдёт. Курьер в прошлый раз написал «рад был помочь» и бросил коробку у двери, это мерзко.

turns.speaker: Олег
turns.text: Приложение у вас тормозит.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Oi Ana, como foi o fim de semana com a família?

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Comi demais no churrasco e agora estou com muita vergonha de contar.

turns.speaker: coach
turns.text: Obrigada por contar. O que você sentiu na hora?

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Na hora estava ótimo, todo mundo rindo, foi divertido de verdade.

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Minha irmã ficou furiosa com o meu cunhado, mas isso é outra história.

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.text: Valeu, até quinta!

turns.speaker: assistente
turns.text: Você tem três reuniões seguidas amanhã à tarde.

turns.speaker: Rafael
turns.text: Que maravilha, mais uma tarde perdida em reunião.

turns.speaker: Rafael
turns.text: Estou com medo de não entregar o relatório até sexta.

turns.speaker: assistente
turns.text: Quer que eu bloqueie a manhã de quinta para o relatório?

turns.speaker: Rafael
turns.text: Sim, por favor. E move a reunião das 16h para segunda.

turns.speaker: Rafael
turns.text: Se o cliente cancelar o contrato, eu ficaria arrasado.

turns.speaker: atendente
turns.text: Encontramos a sua mala, ela chega amanhã de manhã.

turns.speaker: Beatriz
turns.text: Nossa, que alívio! Eu já tinha perdido as esperanças.

turns.speaker: Beatriz
turns.text: O e-mail de vocês dizia "lamentamos profundamente", mas ninguém respondia o telefone, um absurdo.

turns.speaker: atendente
turns.text: Peço desculpas pela demora. Posso confirmar o endereço?

turns.speaker: Beatriz
turns.text: Rua das Flores, 120, apartamento 32.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: The landlord replied: the rent goes up 20% in May.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: ugh.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: fine. draft a reply asking for 10.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Drafted. Want to read it?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: send it

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: lol he said yes to 10. not bad
